crossRefs.note: The third day, there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.

people.name: Galilee
people.line: Region in northern Israel; key location in Jesus' ministry

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

people.name: Judea
people.line: The southern region of Israel, centered around Jerusalem

translations.web: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.
translations.bsb: This was now the second sign that Jesus performed after coming from Judea into Galilee.
translations.kjv: This is again the second miracle that Jesus did, when he was come out of Judaea into Galilee.
translations.asv: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judaea into Galilee.
